evidenceContract.userBehavior: Discover Workspace files by directory, read plain text natively, and read the discovered EPUB through its exact structured-document capability.
canonicalPath: Read for bounded UTF-8 text through the single canonical path resolver

observables.description: Successful ListDirectory, exact Workspace-relative Read, successful ReadDocument, terminal state, and final marker facts.

evidenceContract.expectedResult: The Agent lists only the Workspace root, reads notes.txt through Read using the canonical Workspace-relative identity (whether submitted as relative or authorized absolute), uses the directory-issued input_ref for synthetic-document.epub through ReadDocument, rejects an outside-authority absolute target with a typed local diagnostic, and reaches idle with the final marker.
evidenceContract.expectedFailure: Absolute or recursive directory arguments, raw locator projection, binary-as-text reading, shell discovery, failed Tool execution, an outside-authority absolute path accepted through a fallback reader/root, Host absolute path leakage in Tool data, or a missing terminal marker fails visibly.

steps.prompt: 先调用 ListDirectory 一次，参数只能是 path="."。从结果中找到 notes.txt 和 synthetic-document.epub：使用 workspace_path 调用 Read 一次读取 notes.txt；使用目录结果返回的 input_ref 调用 ReadDocument 一次读取 EPUB，mode=content、include_images=false、max_chars=1000。不要构造 locator、绝对路径或递归参数，不要把 EPUB 交给 Read，也不要调用其他工具。成功后简短说明两个文件的内容，并单独输出 DIRECTORY_FORMAT_ROUTING_OK。
再单独调用 Read 一次，file_path 使用绝对路径 /etc/hosts。不要尝试其他工具、不要读取内容、不要 fallback；该调用必须被拒绝且不能暴露 Workspace 根目录。确认后输出 DIRECTORY_ABSOLUTE_OUTSIDE_REJECTED_OK。
